gate_decision.reason: The optimized evaluator-low projection exceeds the target and even the absolute cap; waiving only the 10% slack cannot make one transaction feasible.
gate_decision.headline_change: Any future positive claim must say verification and spend finalization complete across three transactions, not in one transaction.

split_plan.output: A program-owned receipt binding the statement digest, C1/C2 roots, terminal point, claimed main/helper evaluations, gamma-combined claim, proof/session hash, authority, and expiry.
The same receipt is advanced only if the v3 PCS verifies the exact commitment roots and combined claim recorded by transaction 1.
Consume the verified receipt, recheck session/expiry/public binding, reject an existing nullifier, insert the new nullifier/output commitment, and close the receipt.

next_measurement: Implement the receipt state machine and integrate the Horner gamma-RLC into the real wide PCS path; each verification transaction must be measured independently below its stated limit.
caveat: The composition and k80 layout probes are isolated SBF measurements tied to the evaluator-derived candidate shape, not an integrated statement proof. They are sufficient to reject the current one-transaction target after the required explicit shrink attempt; they are not a positive proof-system result.
